workflow_id.description: Short stable workflow slug. Required for all operations except list.

name.description: Human-readable workflow name. Use empty string for operations that do not need it.

cron.description: Temporal cron expression for recurring workflows. Empty for one-shot workflows.

one_shot_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for one-shot workflows. Empty for recurring workflows.

time_zone_name.description: Always pass empty string. Backend resolves host IANA timezone.

overlap_policy.description: Temporal schedule overlap policy. Use skip by default.

catchup_window.description: Temporal catchup window duration such as 10m. Empty uses backend default.

pause_on_failure.description: Temporal pause_on_failure. Use false unless the user asks to pause after failure.

on_failure.description: V1 supports failure notifications only. Use true by default.

env.description: Global required environment variable names for workflow steps, e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN.

steps.description: Linear durable workflow steps. Logic must live in src/ files; steps only define command boundaries.

command.description: Executable command run from the workflow run directory. Use one executable path/name only; put all arguments in args.

args.description: Command arguments. For Go code, use command go with args like ["run", "./src/package"]. For shell scripts, use command sh with args like ["src/script.sh"].

schedule_to_close_timeout.description: Optional Temporal Activity schedule_to_close_timeout duration. Empty means unset.

files.description: Files to create/update in the workflow bundle. Paths must be under src/. The backend owns workflow.yml and .gitignore.

commit_hash.description: Reserved for future explicit version operations. Pass empty string for create/update/list/describe.

paused.description: For create/update, whether the Temporal schedule starts paused.

limit.description: Maximum workflows to list. Ignored for operations other than list.
